keyPhrases.text: Connor gets himself hither and thither in a complete 360-degree jog, the routine all but thoroughly detracting from the dialogue's romantic beauty
what Gabby Beans does with Mercutio's Queen Mab speech borders on travesty
She treats rhymed iambic pentameter as if it's intended to be sing-songed
The twenty-year-old Connor...speaks his lines, as Hamlet demands, trippingly on the tongue
Gold bombards the audience with a reworking short on poetry and long on physical and vocal horseplay
Most of his fellow cast members...speak the lines not trippingly but as if tripping over them

reasoning: Strong negative review with harsh criticisms of direction, most performances, and overall approach. Only praises Kit Connor while condemning Gold's directorial choices and most other performances. Uses words like 'travesty' and 'bombards' indicating clear disapproval.
